text:
Maria: Quick sync — weekly GPU capacity forecast (EU+APAC). Noticed sustained egress from apac-1 causing cross-region latency spikes. Proposal: shift 6 GPUs (≈48 GPU-hours) from apac-1 to eu-west-2 during tomorrow's crest (02:00-08:00 UTC) and enable dedicated-burst pool for up to 6h if needed.
AJ: Numbers? how confident are we on the 48 GPU-hrs?
Maria: Short calc:
```
Cluster            | Current GPU-hrs | Predicted demand | Buffer
apac-1             | 320             | 360 (+12%)       | -40
eu-west-2          | 410             | 430 (+5%)        | +20
dedicated-burst    | N/A             | can add 6 GPUs   | +144 GPU-hrs
```
Kim: Egress cost impact? moving workload across regions ramps egress by ~1.2TB for the window.
Maria: Ballpark egress charge ~ $0.085/GB => ~ $102 for the shift. Running on dedicated-burst avoids egress but adds reserved cost if we hold long-term.
Jin: FYI apac-1 has inter-region egress cap of 8Gbps between 01:00-08:00 UTC. Last night we peaked at 6.5Gbps for ~20m which triggered queueing.
Leo: If we drain 6 GPUs from apac-1, we should drain low-priority jobs first. I'll prepare a zonal-drain script and tag nodes with `shift-apac-to-eu`.
AJ: What about preemptible risk? If we use preemptible in eu-west-2 we may see 15% failure rate during the window.
Maria: Good call — prefer dedicated-burst for critical routes (chat/generation). Non-critical batch can run on preemptible.
autoscaler-bot: autoscaler-bot queued scale-up: eu-west-2 +6 GPUs at 02:10 UTC (estimated warmup 90s)
Jin: Network ops will hold an eye on peering — if egress>7Gbps we should trigger fallback to local model variant (quantized small model) in apac.
Maria: Decision: 1) Shift 6 GPUs from apac-1 -> eu-west-2 02:00-08:00 UTC. 2) Enable dedicated-burst pool for 6h as failover. 3) Fall back to local quantized model at >7Gbps. 4) Track cost delta and report in Monday capacity readout.
Actions:
- Leo -> prepare zonal-drain + tag (run at 01:50 UTC)
- Jin -> monitor egress and run fallback if needed
- Kim -> add cost estimate to forecast sheet
- AJ -> confirm canary traffic routing and health checks
Maria: I'll own post-mortem if any regressions. :thumbsup:
AJ: ack :thumbsup:
Kim: on it
Leo: prepping script now
autoscaler-bot: scale event executed at 02:11 UTC — eu-west-2 +6 GPUs live
Maria: thanks team — capture notes in capacity dashboard and mark as 'short-term shuffle' in runbook.
